verses.text: LORD, I come to you for safety. Never let me be put to shame.
Because you do what is right, rescue me and save me. Turn your ear to me and save me.
Be my rock of safety where I can always go. Give the command to save me, because you are my rock and my fortress.
My God, rescue me from the power of the wicked, from the grip of evil and cruel people.
Lord GOD, you are my hope. I have trusted you since I was young.
I have depended on you since I was born. You brought me out of my mother's womb. I will always praise you.
My life is an example to many people, because you are my strong place of safety.
My mouth is full of your praise. I tell of your glory all day long.
Do not throw me away when I am old. Do not leave me when my strength is gone.
My enemies talk against me. Those who are waiting to kill me plot together.
They say, "God has left him. Go after him and catch him, because no one will rescue him."
God, do not stay far away from me. My God, hurry to help me.
Let those who accuse me be put to shame and destroyed. Let those who want to hurt me be covered with shame and disgrace.
But I will always have hope. I will praise you more and more.
All day long I will tell how you do what is right and how you save, even though I cannot understand it all.
I will come and tell about the mighty acts of the Lord GOD. I will remind everyone that you alone do what is right.
God, you have taught me since I was young. To this day I tell about the amazing things you do.
Even when I am old and grey, God, do not leave me. Let me tell the next generation about your strength, and everyone still to come about your power.
God, your goodness reaches to the skies. You have done great things. God, who is like you?
You have let me see many bitter troubles, but you will give me life again. You will bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
You will make me even more honoured, and you will comfort me again.
I will praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I will sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.
My lips will shout for joy as I sing praises to you. I will sing because you have rescued me.
My tongue will talk about how you do what is right all day long, because those who wanted to hurt me have been put to shame and confused.
